Create a shipment

POST /v2/shipments

Creates a shipment and, if a rate is selected, buys the postage label in the same request. The response includes a label URL, a tracking number, and the final price, which may differ slightly from the quoted price when the carrier applies surcharges.

Requests are idempotent when you send an Idempotency-Key header, so a retry after a network error will never buy a second label. Keys expire after 24 hours.

Body parameters

NameTypeDescription
from_addressobjectSender address. Required.
to_addressobjectRecipient address. Required.
parcelobjectWeight in grams and dimensions in millimetres.
rate_idstringA rate from a previous quote. Omit it to create an unpaid draft.
referencestringYour own order number, up to 64 characters.

Errors

  • 400 invalid_address – one of the addresses could not be verified.
  • 402 insufficient_balance – your prepaid balance does not cover the label.
  • 409 rate_expired – the quote is older than 30 minutes; request a new one.

See Handling errors for retry advice, and Get a quote for how to obtain a rate_id.

curl https://api.parcelpost.dev/v2/shipments \
  -u $PARCELPOST_KEY: \
  -d rate_id=rate_8hX2 \
  -d reference=ORDER-1042
Response
{ "id": "shp_91K", "status": "purchased", "tracking_number": "PP1234567890" }
